Observed_Symptom: Chat text and code blocks squashed to 30px unreadable slivers
Root_Cause: _content.document().size().height() evaluated to 1 prior to layout clamping setFixedHeight(30) with ScrollBarAlwaysOff
Repair_Applied: Replaced with auto-sizing QTextBrowser with markdown layout and dynamic resizeEvent height calculation
Retest_Result: Multi-line text and 30-line C++ code blocks display completely without clipping

Observed_Symptom: Bottom terminal occupied ~380px vertical space squashing central chat
Root_Cause: Missing resizeDocks() initial geometry configuration in QMainWindow
Repair_Applied: Added setCorner() and explicit resizeDocks([_dock_terminal] [160] Qt.Vertical)
Retest_Result: Terminal constrained to 160px; central chat area receives 650px+ vertical height

Observed_Symptom: Global QWidget background rule caused child containers to inherit solid black backgrounds
Root_Cause: QWidget { background-color: #0d0f14; } applied globally to all QWidget subclasses
Repair_Applied: Scoped background-color to top-level windows and containers (QMainWindow QDialog QDockWidget)
Retest_Result: High contrast palette (>12:1 ratio) with crisp typography and distinct role borders

Observed_Symptom: Unreal 5.7 detected but Install Path empty and UAT reported unavailable
Root_Cause: Tool returned engine_root instead of install_path; UAT check looked for non-existent path
Retest_Result: Install path reports E:\UE\UE_5.7 and UAT reports Yes (RunUAT)

Observed_Symptom: 64 duplicate-looking GameForgePilot entries in project list
Root_Cause: find_uprojects() scanned all subdirectories including reports/ scratch/ and build intermediates
Repair_Applied: Filtered out build and temp folders; added relative fixture directory tags to display names
Retest_Result: Deduplicated list showing 5 distinct workspace test fixtures

Observed_Symptom: Buttons clipped under Windows display scaling (Clear as lea; New Session as New Sessior)
Root_Cause: Fixed button widths (48px and 100px) too narrow for label text plus padding
Repair_Applied: Enlarged button dimensions with minimum widths (58px for Clear; 110px for New Session)
Retest_Result: Button text renders completely without truncation across display scales

Observed_Symptom: RuntimeWarning: coroutine method aclose was never awaited
Root_Cause: Async generator stream_gen was abandoned on early return in _stream() without closing
Repair_Applied: Added try...finally: await stream_gen.aclose() and loop.shutdown_asyncgens() in run()
Retest_Result: Clean thread shutdown without unhandled warnings

Observed_Symptom: No quick toolbar toggle to collapse/expand terminal dock
Root_Cause: Terminal visibility only accessible through View menu or Ctrl+`
Repair_Applied: Added toggleable Terminal action button to top toolbar bidirectionally synced with dock
Retest_Result: One-click workspace maximization to hide/show terminal
